title: OpenGDD v0.7 drawer label (_collection.json)

record.$comment: The optional record schema uses the closed field grammar: type (number, integer, string, grid, link, list), required or when (row domain), options, pattern, unique, description; link adds to/many/loops/mirrored_by and list adds recursive of. Grammar, target, existence, loop, and mirror checks are validator-level; with a schema present every record is validated against it.
record.description: Optional record schema; field name to field shape

$comment: The label is optional and appears only when it has something to say. record is its one field; a drawer with no label holds free-form designer data.
